notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
"Dragon" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.
description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a copy of the Realm-Scorcher Hellkite spell.
Resolve the copy of the Realm-Scorcher Hellkite spell.
When the token Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding four mana of any color(s).
Resolve the original Realm-Scorcher Hellkite spell .When the nontoken Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego paying the bargain cost to get infinite copies of Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, or use its ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
